ot_meso_fifo.clock_relation: Equal nominal 1.2GHz, arbitrary phase; safe synchronized pointer fallback. Not a 3:4-ratio or 976.6MHz HBM FIFO.

ports.write: wclk, wrst_n, w_v, w_rdy, w_d[W-1:0], w_live, w_fault
ports.read: rclk, rrst_n, r_v, r_rdy, r_d[W-1:0], r_live, r_fault

ot_meso_fifo.credit: Only r_v && r_rdy advances rp and returns Gray read pointer through 3FF; registered output does not create a fifth credit.
ot_meso_fifo.reset: Synchronous per-domain reset. DOWN/HOLD8 -> WAIT -> RUN, logical zero-pointer alignment; synchronized peer state. Both ports quiesce during flush; not atomic across independent clocks.
ot_meso_fifo.drift: 3FF synchronized Gray clock counters; signed modulo count error beyond +/-2 from RUN anchor is sticky and locally inhibits transfers. No analog phase/TDC or raw-pointer safety claim.
ot_meso_fifo.clock_stop: Only running port can progress to fault. Stopped port may retain valid level but has no accept edge. Reset both ports before restart.
ot_meso_fifo.protection: Current candidate flops unqualified for mutable-state protection; integrate protected storage/control contract and reprice before adoption.

ot_fwd_link_stage.ports: fclk_i, rst_n, i_v, i_d, fclk_o, o_v, o_d
ot_fwd_link_stage.flow: Fixed-latency valid/data stage; no ready signal or credits. Parent launch schedule must reserve downstream FIFO capacity before any in-flight completion.
ot_fwd_link_stage.physical_scope: Standalone compact route probe only; cannot certify 430.56um channel or filtered-clock rail. Parent must time true source->sink geometry/loads and generated clocks.

related_ratio.scope: Local same-PLL 3.6GHz /3 and /4 only; W64 both directions and W512 fast->slow measured. No arbitrary-phase reuse.

constraints.spelling: OpenSTA -ignore_clock_latency; all cross-clock arcs bounded, data included. Gray skew <= source period via per-bit max bound; payload held to synchronized publication/real credit.
constraints.unknown_phase_signoff: Synchronizer/metastability MTBF requires characterization; a phase-sweep simulation is not proof.
constraints.parent_forwarded_clock: Replace standalone incoming create_clock with real parent clock; create generated clock at each real mapped forwarded output, retain opposite-edge capture; no fake independent roots.

required_parent_gates: Primitive clock rejection resolved by separately authorized replacement, not by relaxing clock/uncertainty or hiding paths.
Actual Qwen logits/VM/KV and DS L0/L20/root identities bit-identical with all finite stalls.
Source-matched issue/rate price for D4 measured0.444..0.5 word/cycle; latency-only token term is insufficient.
Real pin/PG/layer/clock rail and span in context; SS setup and FF hold at60/25ps.
Protected mutable FIFO state/control and epoch/address/transaction contracts.
